item.title: Park maintenance back log reaches almost $329 Million
item.description: (COLORADO SPRINGS) —The City of Colorado Springs faces a $329 million maintenance backlog for its park system. The backlog includes a wide range of needs, from resurfacing tennis courts to repairing parking lots and facilities. This year, the parks department is scheduled to see $950,000 in budget cuts, leaving few resources to address long-term repairs. [...]
